title: Player checks in from the header
description: Use the header location control to check yourself in or out without the kiosk. The /me hub has the same control as a large tile.

steps.title: Header check-in
steps.body: The pin control is next to your profile. Gray means you are out; green means you are present. This capture does not submit a check-in.

steps.title: Same control on /me
steps.body: On the phone hub the tile is labeled Check in or Check out. Payment may be required before a club-day check-in succeeds.
